    max_element = max(arr)

    # Initialize a count array with zeros
    count = [0] * (max_element + 1)

    # Count the occurrences of each element
    for num in arr:

    # Build the sorted array

        sorted_arr.extend([i] * freq)

        power += 1
    return decimal
